name: no-card-buy
description: The paired control for the card BUY (Dean, 2026-08-03), which ships ON in the base data - so this sweep runs BACKWARDS from the live rule, as the coin-flood sweep now does for the pity. Switching buyCost to null restores the pre-buy game exactly: no free action, no coin-to-card exchange, coins spendable only on hiring, the two starter flips and the coin-priced cards. Read every delta as what the buy DOES, sign flipped.
